caption: The drawing is composed of black ink lines on an off-white rectangular sheet, bordered by a simple black outline. In the upper left quadrant, four horizontal profiles of architectural moldings are arranged vertically, each differing slightly in curvature and line thickness. The upper right quadrant features a partial arc, resembling a section of a clock face or stair railing, with regularly spaced Roman numerals and decorative motifs placed between. Near the center of the page, three standalone ornamental elements are arranged: a vertical symmetrical shape with a spiked top, a small linear shape with stepped segments, and a curvilinear form with a circular spiral and ornate details extending to the right. To the lower right, a stylized leaf-like or floral motif is present. The entire composition is rendered in monochrome, with no shading or color other than the black lines and the off-white background. The lower right corner of the page features a handwritten name, "Ernest Towers Sr."
title: Grandfather's Clock
